name: 32887-mtbench-8b-1gpu
model: unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (target) + amd/PARD-Llama-3.2-1B (drafter), speculative method `draft_model`, 8 speculated tokens.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; the drafter follows the target and no drafter parallel degree is set.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 8.03B, bf16, 16.06 GB, KV 128 KiB/token. Drafter: LlamaForCausalLM, 1.24B, bf16, 3.00 GB, vocab 128256 -- equal to the target's, which the draft-model path requires.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 320 requests / 2700 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: `configs/data/mtbench-turn1.jsonl`, the 80 first turns of `philschmid/mt-bench` (question_id 81-160, 10 each of eight categories), cycled 4 times to make the 320-request bound. The backend renders each row as a {"role":"user"} message and applies the target's own chat template, which adds 35 tokens; wire prompts run 47-384 tokens, mean 100.7. Greedy (temperature 0.0), output capped at 256 tokens with EOS honoured (`ignore_eos: false`), so output length varies per prompt.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant on one GPU, answering short varied questions with an 8-billion-parameter model and a small draft model.
launch:
# Engine args for the pinned commit (v0.15.2rc0-26-g5b2a9422f0f4). They reach AsyncEngineArgs by
# name, so a key borrowed from a later vLLM is an error at engine construction.
# `speculative-config` is one JSON object and must stay on ONE line.
model: unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
speculative-config: {"model": "amd/PARD-Llama-3.2-1B", "method": "draft_model", "num_speculative_tokens": 8}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 8
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
